name: Etrean Guardmaster
desc: Etrean Guardsmaster is an Etrean NPC. The player is able to break off their handcuffs if they have been sent to execution by an Authority NPC or an Authority Ensign.
additional_info:
-   If you talk to them when one minute remains, it reads "1 minutes remain."
    -   If you talk to them when less than a minute remains, no remaining time is displayed.
-   The Shipping Schedule dialogue takes priority over the Handcuffs dialogue, and because you cannot hold any items while handcuffed, this softlocks you.
goals: Rescue the [Etrean Guardsman Hostages](entity:etrean_guardsman_hostage) held in [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit)'s cells
